root_causes.secondary: SfePy v2026.2 evaluate API is broken — integral registration fails when creating evaluation expressions. Had to compute stress manually from deformation gradient (same approach as Round 82).
root_causes.tertiary: SfePy v2026.2 Term._check_variables has a tuple bug (patched locally, documented).
